p: eagle with great wings: That is, Nebuchadnezzar who had great power, riches and many countries under him, will come to Jerusalem and take away Jeconiah the king, as in Eze 17:12.
seed of the land: That is, Zedekiah who was of the king's blood and was left at Jerusalem and made king instead of Jeconiah, 2Ki 24:17, Jer 37:1.
a spreading vine of: This was Zedekiah's kingdom.
low stature: That is, might not have power to rebel against Babylon, as in Eze 17:14.
another great eagle with great wings: Meaning, the king of Egypt from whom Zedekiah sought comfort against Nebuchadnezzar.
waters: They thought to be moistened by the waters of the Nile.
he not pull up its roots: Shall not Nebuchadnezzar destroy it?
when the east wind toucheth it: By this dry wind he means the Babylonians.
an oath from him: For his subjection and obedience.

his hand: Because he took the name of God in vain, and broke his oath which he had confirmed by giving his hand: therefore the prophet declares that God would not permit such perjury and infidelity to escape punishment.
of the high cedar: This promise is made to the Church which will be as a small remnant, and as the top of a tree.
top of its young twigs a: I will trim it, and dress it.
fowl of every wing: Both the Jews and Gentiles will be gathered into it.
trees of the field shall know: All the world will know that I have plucked down the proud enemies, and set up my Church which was low and contemned.
